Code

Work in progress... But you can find some of the code I developed on GitHub


Tutorials


R packages


  • proSeq - processing single-cell RNA-seq data. Including QC, detection of Highly Variable Genes, PCA...
  • anSeq - Functions to help analyse single-cell RNA-seq data - plot gene expression profiles, clustering...

Analysis pipelines


  • EmbryoTimecourse2018 - Mouse gastrulation single-cell RNA-seq (10X) atlas. (Pijuan-Sala, Griffiths, Guibentif et al., 2019)
  • MouseOrganogenesis_snATACseq_2020 - Single-nucleus ATAC-seq of early mouse organogenesis. (Pijuan-Sala, et al., 2020)

Websites/Rshiny apps developed


  • Website for 'A single-cell resolution map of mouse hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell differentiation'- (Nestorowa, Hamey, et al., Blood, 2016)
  • Rshiny app for 'A single-cell hematopoietic landscape resolves 8 lineage trajectories and defects in Kit mutant mice'- (Dahlin et al., Blood, 2018). Currently down.
  • Rshiny app for 'Single-cell chromatin accessibility maps reveal regulatory programs driving early mouse organogenesis'- (Pijuan-Sala et al., Nat Cell Biol, 2020). Currently down.
